about_the_game:
Her long awaited vacation cut short by an orbital invasion, bounty hunter Ethelyn Dax takes on a whole army of mercenaries and their robotic auxiliaries to reconquer the resort city of Ctesiphon.

Blast your way through the first two levels of the full game. Fighting ignorant grunts and headless cloned cyborgs with whatever guns you can steal or simply sticking them with your trusty data-spike.

content_descriptors.notes: Game features violence, plunging necklines, and some occasional crude language
